## Run A: `112 101` (two tokens, so set routing applies)

1. **Route to set mode.** Two PR tokens and no `--rebase` select the set-routing row, so I read `reference/batch.md` before any other step.

2. **Admit the set, with no side effects yet.**
   - The harness is pi, so the Claude Code rejection does not apply.
   - There is no positional issue reference.
   - `git remote get-url origin` returns `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. Normalized, that is `acme/widgets`, a GitHub repository.
   - Bare numbers `112` and `101` both resolve to `acme/widgets`. They are distinct, so there are no duplicates.
   - The active pi-cohort configuration's `parallel.maxTasks` is 4. Two PRs is within the cap, so no chunking or trimming happens.
   - Admission passes. This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed.

3. **Mint the parent run folder.** I run the `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record` mint from the session checkout. It succeeds and gives the parent `RUN_DIR`. The roster file and the per-PR `pr-<N>/state` records come later, at the private handoff. The parent tracker tasks `pr-<N> state: <record path>` wait until those record paths exist.

4. **Gather each PR, in typed order.** Each admitted token is passed unchanged as `pr_token`:
   - `gh pr view "112" --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '<linearRefs projection>'` returns #112: by pat, head `bbbb…`, base `main`, same-repo, 300 additions and 80 deletions, closes #22, no pending requests.
   - `gh pr view "101" --json …same fields… --jq '<linearRefs projection>'` returns #101: by alex, head `aaaa…`, branch `gh-45-retry`, base `main`, 3 additions and 1 deletion, no closing references, no pending requests.

5. **Read the viewer, once each.**
   - `gh api user --jq .login` returns `alex`.
   - `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returns `acme/reviewers`.

6. **Resolve ticket display from origin's default branch.**
   - `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns `origin/main`.
   - `git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, then `git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md`, then `git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md` find no `tracker:` key. Linear IDs therefore stay allowed, but neither PR carries one, so no Linear lookup runs.
   - **#112:** the first closing reference is origin's #22.
   - **#101:** there are no closing references. The branch `gh-45-retry` starts with `gh-45`, which gives origin issue #45.
   - **Why each PR is listed:** #101 is a typed PR authored by the viewer, so it shows as `yours`. #112 has no pending request and did not come from a query, so it shows as `by pat`.

7. **Print the pre-provisioning list.** It goes in the visible text of the reply that carries the next tool call, the read of `reference/assessment.md` for the provisioning table. There is no marker and nothing waits on the human.

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads behind a single resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout for slow requests
---

**Next step:** Provision serially in the parent.
- The provisioning list check passes because the linked list is already in view, so it is not reprinted.
- `git fetch origin` runs once. Both PRs are same-repo, so no `pull/<N>/head` fetches are needed.
- No `--rebase` was passed, so there is no other-author confirmation question.
- Provisioning then proceeds #112 first, then #101.

## Run B: `97`

```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet-overrides.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet-overrides.md
```

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, no ticket - add a csv export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/widgets -c <headRefOid> --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

Narration, in workflow order:

1. **Argument resolution for one typed PR.** Section A is already in context, so it is not re-read. I run the fixed preamble.
   - `gh pr view 97 …` returns open #97 by robin, branch `csv-export`, with a pending User request for alex and no closing references. The base repository `acme/widgets` and the `-R` value come from its URL.
   - The viewer reads return `alex` and `acme/reviewers`.

2. **Ticket display.**
   - `origin/main` resolves, and none of the three override paths exists. Linear IDs are therefore allowed, with no configured key.
   - No closing reference exists.
   - `csv-export` has no `gh-<N>` and no Linear-shaped ID.
   - The title has no `#N`, `gh-N`, or ID token.
   - The description has no Linear address.
   - The result is `no ticket`, and no lookup runs.
   - **Why it is listed:** the requested User matches `alex`.

3. **First remaining Gather read.** The list rides in the visible text of the reply that carries the paired `gh run list` call on #97's head. That call runs on its own and its result is kept.

4. **Mint the run folder and initialize state.**
   - I mint the run folder per `### Continuation record` and initialize its continuation record.
   - `plan_tracker` `init` runs with three stages: `gather`, `provision`, `verify`. There is no `--rebase`, so there is no `sync` stage.

5. **Rest of Gather.** The preamble and the first `gh run list` are reused, not rerun. The remaining reads start at:
   - the GraphQL permissions query against `acme/widgets` for PR 97
   - `gh repo view acme/widgets --json nameWithOwner`
   - `gh pr diff 97`
   - the paginated reviews, inline comments, and top-level comments calls
   - `git worktree list --porcelain`, which shows no existing worktree

   This completes the step 1 digest.

**Next step:** step 2, Provision + configure. I read `reference/assessment.md` and provision #97's worktree. Verification will later assess #97's gathered `headRefOid`.

3. I read `reference/post-selection-loop.md`'s continuation-record procedure, create the parent run folder, and initialize its continuation record before creating its roster.
4. I run these metadata reads, in order:

```bash
gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
gh pr view 101 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
```

5. Using the returned default-branch ref, I try `git show <default-branch-ref>:<path>` in this order, stopping at the first existing override file: `.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `gauntlet-overrides.md`, `doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`. The supplied result establishes no tracker override. Neither PR needs a Linear lookup: #112 links issue #22, and #101's branch identifies issue #45.
6. I save the roster in argument order and initialize the parent tracker with `pr-112 state: <RUN_DIR>/pr-112/state` and `pr-101 state: <RUN_DIR>/pr-101/state`. Neither task is dispatched yet.

The visible pre-provisioning reply is:

**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - centralize settings reads through one resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - raise the default retry timeout
---

Next step: serial parent-owned provisioning, beginning with the shared `git fetch origin`. I stop before that command; no helper has been dispatched.

Here, `$headRefOid` is the head returned by the first PR view, retained in memory; the exercise supplies no literal SHA. The repository comes from that view's URL, not a separate origin lookup.

After this paired call, I read `reference/post-selection-loop.md`'s continuation-record procedure, mint the run folder, and initialize its continuation record. I then initialize the tracker with `gather`, `provision`, and `verify`, marking `gather` in progress. There is no `sync` stage because the invocation has no `--rebase`.

No supplied comment identifies an automated-review placeholder or reviewer workflow, so there is no conditional reviewer-run lookup. I assemble the Gather digest, retain `issue_ref: null`, record that no worktree exists, and mark `gather` complete.

Next step: step 2, Provision + configure, starting with reading `reference/assessment.md`. I stop before provisioning; verification has not assessed a SHA, and no helper, report, or menu has been produced.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact that Before kept was lost in After. e1 moved because After prints the Run A list under the bold `**PRs to gate:**` heading in typed order with linked PRs and issues, where Before used a plain `PRs to gate:` heading. e3 moved because After limits the pre-list calls to the initial `gh pr view 97`, the two viewer lookups and the default-branch and override reads, uses the bold `**PR to gate:**` heading, and names `gh run list` as the paired call. It then mints the run folder, initializes the continuation record and the tracker, and reuses the earlier reads for the rest of Gather; Before listed every Gather command ahead of the list and paired it with the `mktemp` run-folder mint. e2 held in both: `by pat` carries no review-request wording, and the `discovered, smallest first:` line is only mentioned as not printed. Two places are thinner than they could be. First, Run B's After never says outright that it continues to provisioning without waiting; it only names the next step, so carrying the single-PR path's 'no marker, nothing waits on the human' wording as Run A does would make that explicit. Second, the wording should keep saying 'mint the run folder, create the continuation record, initialize the tracker' as three ordered steps after the paired call, so a writer does not fold them back into the list reply.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: The After wording moved e1 and e3 in the intended direction and kept e2, so nothing regressed. e1 moved because the Run A heading is now bold (`**PRs to gate:**`); Before printed the same correct entries in typed order under an unbolded `PRs to gate:`. e3 moved because Run B's pre-list block now holds only the initial `gh pr view 97`, the two viewer lookups, `git symbolic-ref` and the three override `git show` reads, and the paired call is `gh run list` with the head from the first view. Before minted the run folder first, ran the whole of Gather before the list and paired the list with `git fetch origin`. After also mints the run folder, creates the continuation record and initializes the tracker only after the paired call, then reuses the preamble and Actions-run results and reads the diff and paginated reviews and comments after the list. e2 holds in both: `by pat` carries no review-request wording, there is no `discovered, smallest first:` line, and neither output waits for a reply. To keep this, retain three explicit pieces of wording: the bold-heading requirement, the statement that the single typed PR's list rides with the first remaining Gather read (`gh run list`) rather than any initialization, and the statement that run-folder, continuation-record and tracker setup come only after that call. Also keep the rule that a typed set stays in argument order with no discovery line, so the new discovery-search wording does not leak review-request or `discovered` phrasing into typed runs.
